name: Sophie
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Sophie is located in the quiet district of Wörgltal in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tiroler district of Kufstein. The accommodation is suitable for two to four people and has a fully equipped kitchen as well as a balcony with a view of the surrounding meadows. Guests reach the Thierseetal-Liftanlage in about ten minutes on foot. The apartment offers functional furnishings for those seeking relaxation who would like to experience the Tiroler mountain world in a simple way.
